name: Arc Ctrl+Tab
description: Arc-style Ctrl+Tab tab switcher: hold Ctrl and press Tab to see a row of tab previews in most-recently-used order, release Ctrl to jump to the highlighted tab. Turns on Zen's built-in switcher and restyles it with your theme's colors.
author: dvgmdvgm

JS/arc-ctrltab.uc.js.name: Arc Ctrl+Tab
JS/arc-ctrltab.uc.js.description: Switches on the recently-used Ctrl+Tab panel that ships with Zen.
